papers.s1: A fair and clean test of lessons 1-3 that covers them evenly. For the first time the grammar part really tests what 乐读 teaches: stroke order, first and second strokes, and pictographs (Q23-29). It is on the easy side (一 = one, 八 = eight, three → 三), and the fill distractors are so absurd (百/千/万 for '有___天', 雨伞/王子/火车 for '吃___面') that vocabulary is nearly free. The only structural fault is the same cup dialogue printed twice (Q39, Q40).
papers.final: Much better than round 2. Coverage of lessons 1-10 is even, hand items no longer leak, reply option sets don't repeat, and the grammar part is a real character-knowledge test (strokes, 意符/声符, components). What remains: five reading texts are printed twice for two questions each, several fill and blank items have wrong options of the wrong type, two stems contain their own answer, and two order items still accept a second order. Listening is easy but fair, and it feels like a real exam.

findings.reason: In the same part, Q11 plays '我开车去' and prints '开车' as its answer, which settles the hear item 开车.
findings.suggest: Don't use a hear word that is the printed answer of a dialog in the same part (one test per word should include dialog answers).

findings.reason: '一个星期有___天' with 百/千/万: none of these can stand alone as a number, so only 七 is grammatical.
findings.suggest: Use other digits: 五 / 六 / 八 / 七.

findings.reason: '今天晚饭吃___面' with 雨伞/王子/火车: only 牛肉 is food.
findings.suggest: Offer foods that don't go with 面 here, e.g. 苹果 / 西瓜 / 牛奶 / 牛肉.

findings.reason: The six-line cup dialogue ('这个杯子多少钱？…') is printed twice, as Q39 and Q40.
findings.suggest: Print a text once with its questions under it, or use each text once per paper.

findings.reason: '这个面包我吃___，你吃一半。' prints the answer 一半 right after the blank.
findings.suggest: Rewrite, e.g. '这个面包很大，我们一人吃___。', with 一半 as the answer.

findings.reason: '今天晚饭吃___面' with 王子/雨伞/火车: only 牛肉 is food.
findings.suggest: Offer foods: 苹果 / 西瓜 / 牛奶 / 牛肉.

findings.reason: '我在家___。' with 天气/期末/中国: all wrong options are nouns, and only the verb 上网 fits.
findings.suggest: Use verbs that fail on sense or lesson, e.g. 上班 / 开车 / 上课 / 上网 (or a fuller stem).

findings.reason: '他在家___汉语。' with 现金/手表/电话: all nouns, and only the verb 自学 fits.
findings.suggest: Use verbs: 自学 / 唱歌 / 回家 / 上网.

findings.reason: '我早饭喝___。' with 国王/苹果/火腿: only 牛奶 is a drink.
findings.suggest: Offer drinks that fail on sense (啤酒 for breakfast is weak too); better to make it a stroke or component item, or use 热水 / 冰水 / 牛奶 with a clue such as '天冷'.

findings.reason: '下雨了，我要带___。' with 牛肉/火车/水果: only 雨伞 can be carried for rain, and it repeats 雨 from the stem.
findings.suggest: Use carryable things: 雨伞 / 手机 / 面包 / 自行车, or drop the item from blank.

findings.reason: The stem '和月亮、时间有关' contains the answer 月.
findings.suggest: Write '和时间有关' only.

findings.reason: '你累了，在家___息一下吧' repeats Q68's '你累了，___吧', whose printed answer is 休息; the word is tested twice.
findings.suggest: Count component blanks as testing their whole word (休息), so one test per word covers them.

findings.reason: '生菜、菜单、白菜都和“___”有关' prints 菜 three times in the stem.
findings.suggest: Remove this item type, or show the words in pinyin and ask for the shared character.

findings.reason: The cup dialogue of Q118 is printed again in full.
findings.suggest: Print a text once with its questions under it, or use each text once per paper.

findings.reason: The cinema text of Q121 is printed again in full.
findings.suggest: Same as Q119.

findings.reason: The grandma text of Q123 is printed again in full.
findings.suggest: Same as Q119.

findings.reason: The principal text of Q125 is printed again in full.
findings.suggest: Same as Q119.

findings.reason: '他喜欢喝咖啡吗？' is answered '喜欢，他的爱好是听音乐。', a non sequitur, and the question asks about exactly that line.
findings.suggest: Write '喜欢。他的爱好是听音乐。' as two moves, or have the question line be '他有什么爱好？'.

findings.reason: The shoe-shop text of Q129 is printed again in full.
findings.suggest: Same as Q119.

findings.reason: '我很高兴见到你。' is as acceptable as '见到你我很高兴。'
findings.suggest: Accept both, or join '见到你' into one tile and accept both orders.

findings.reason: '我夏天爱吃西瓜。' is as correct as '夏天我爱吃西瓜。'
findings.suggest: Accept the time word before or after the subject.

rules: Show a reading text once and put all its questions under it; never print the same text as separate items.

Fill and blank distractors must be the same part of speech and from the same field as the answer (foods for '吃___面', drinks for '喝___', verbs for '在家___', digits for '有___天'), so that they fail only on meaning or collocation.
Reject any stem that contains its answer character or word: '月亮' with answer 月, '生菜、菜单、白菜' with 菜, '你吃一半' with 一半.
Order items: accept a time word before or after the subject, and both '见到你我很高兴' and '我很高兴见到你'.
Count a component blank (___息, 五___六色) and a dialog's printed answer as testing that word, so the one-test-per-word rule covers them.
